title: Education deserts after university licensing in Peru: code and data
description: Python pipeline, public source data and derived datasets that reproduce every table and figure of the article Education Deserts after University Licensing: Geographic and Field-Specific Access to Undergraduate Programs in Peru. It measures university deserts by field of study with straight-line distance and road and river travel time, estimates their territorial correlates and association with participation, simulates the effect of the SUNEDU license denials, and solves a maximal covering location model.
